feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player routing and chooser fields so effects can make an opponent, each player, or a targeted player choose, sacrifice, vote, reveal, reselect, or pay, including per-opponent conditions and opponent-chosen objects.

feature: Rule statics and permissions that do not exist yet
description: Add rule statics for global or per-player spell cost increases, land-play bans, graveyard cast and activation bans, extra blocking, forced or conditional attack and block restrictions, haste-like attack permission, hexproof-like targeting protection for attached creatures, legend-rule suppression, hand-size reductions, damage-unpreventable turns, damage-prevention scopes, and keyword grants to spells.

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (delve, echo, myriad, decayed, splice)
description: Add keyword mechanics and grantable keywords the schema lacks: myriad, delve, skulk, fear, buyback, madness, miracle, foretell, warp, awaken, embalm and eternalize subtype overrides, ninjutsu entry, firebending mana, cascade grants, partner variants, incubate, earthbend, airbend, and time travel.
cards: All of History, All at Once

feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events and filters for cycling this card, a creature dealing damage to any object, fully unlocking a Room, becoming the target of an ability you control, once-each-turn limits on cast and attack triggers, and cycling versus discard distinctions.

feature: Game-state conditions and values
description: Add conditions and values for the top card's color, a player with no cards in hand, distinct mana values in a graveyard, cast-from-hand and cast-from-graveyard checks, one land of each basic type with a creature of each color, mana spent on an ability, summed counts, and cards-in-graveyard payment amounts.

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Add target slots and selectors that accept an announced X, a chosen number, or any number of objects, including group effects over each chosen creature and X-bounded mana value, power, and search filters.

feature: Optional choices and if-you-do follow-ups
description: Add may-decline forms and follow-up effects gated on whether an optional action, discard, exile, sacrifice, payment or return actually happened, including repeat-while-you-do loops and reflexive triggers with their own targets.

feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Add selector and condition predicates for current-state keywords such as flying, exact power and toughness, power equal to energy paid, lesser power, subtype comparisons with an attached creature, unrestricted card filters, any-kind counters, and per-opponent graveyard counts.

feature: Ability cost forms
description: Add cost forms: card-type-filtered discards, any-kind counter removal, return-self-to-hand costs, forage, snow mana symbols, and counter removal for library-top casts.

feature: Amounts produced by the previous effect or event
description: Add Values that read amounts and objects from earlier in the resolution or from the event: sacrificed or exiled card power, toughness and mana value, excess damage, life gained, counters on the dying creature, cards drawn this turn, creatures convoked, greatest mana value, Locus counts, per-player land counts, and the found card's mana value.
cards: Ob Nixilis of the Black Oath

feature: Reveal/exile/mill-until loops with leftovers handling
description: Add reveal-until, exile-until, mill-and-choose, and look-at-top ops with unrestricted filters, any-number picks, and leftovers sent to hand or library.

feature: Turn-history conditions
description: Add per-turn history tracking and conditions such as cards leaving the graveyard, permanents leaving the battlefield (Revolt), descended, lands entering, creature cards put into a graveyard, first combat phase, once-per-turn limits on triggers, and cast-time checks.

feature: Ability removal and base power/toughness overrides
description: Add effects and durations that remove all abilities, set base power and toughness from X or another creature's power, copy until your next turn, grant or remove a chosen keyword on a target, and turn a noncreature permanent into a creature with granted abilities.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add tapped, tapped-and-attacking, untapped-under-owner, counter, subtype, and attach options for permanents entering from graveyard, hand or exile, including token copies with added subtypes or colors and attaching chosen Equipment.

feature: Combat and damage assignment effects
description: Add damage forms with per-source amounts, assign-as-though-unblocked, group-scoped combat damage prevention with counters, creature-controller damage targets, delayed triggers bound to damaged creatures, and extra combat phases limited to chosen attackers.

feature: Search destinations and graveyard returns
description: Add search and return forms with destination chosen by mana value, any number of found cards, name-exclusion filters, untargeted multi-card graveyard returns, finality counters, delayed returns at the next upkeep, and cards exiled from a library with a cast permission.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add modern keyword actions and game-state effects: the Ring tempts you, taking the initiative, rolling dice, rad counters, end the turn, controlling another player's turn, and winning the game.

feature: Control changes and durations tied to controlling the source
description: Add permanent exchange-of-control, durations lasting as long as the source remains, and stolen-object statics.

feature: Fractional and difference amounts
description: Add Values for a third of a quantity rounded up and for differences between two counts, such as hand size minus four or the gap between an opponent's land count and yours.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add free casts from graveyards, exile, or hand with mana value filters and exile-instead riders.

feature: Stack, spell copy and spell-targeting effects
description: Add stack interaction for exiling or countering all other spells and abilities, countering the triggering spell, targeting the controller of a spell, retargeting a copy to a just-created token, and spell copies that are not legendary.

feature: Random, guessed and hidden-information choices
description: Add chosen numbers, odd or even choices, guesses against a revealed mana value, private looks at a hand, random selection among exiled cards, and per-reveal token creation.

feature: Life totals and game-result effects
description: Add set-life-total effects, life-total reads, and clamped life-based amounts.

feature: one-off
description: Single cards with their own missing feature: a validator rejection of an already-parsed generic-label line, a clash effect, a delayed exile of a created token, and the Junk token's play-the-exiled-card ability.
